summary: Tested mobile responsiveness for Website Projects page at 390x844 viewport. All major mobile features are working correctly: card-based project list, bottom navigation bar, mobile-friendly modals, and responsive headers. One minor issue found: bottom nav buttons for Info/Brand tabs are blocked by Emergent badge overlay in preview environment (works via JS click and top tab bar).

issues: Info and Brand buttons in bottom nav are blocked by Emergent badge overlay in preview environment. The buttons work correctly when clicked via JavaScript or when using the top tab bar. This is an environment-specific issue, not a code bug.

seed_data_creation: Used existing projects (Acacia Homess) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness for Website Projects page fully tested at 390x844 viewport. Features verified: 1) Card-based project list showing name, status badge, progress bar, page count, and chevron 2) Bottom navigation bar with 5 tabs: Projects, Tasks, New (elevated), Filter, More 3) Mobile search bar and quick filter pills (Projects, Tasks, Filter) 4) Expandable filters panel with Status and Developer dropdowns 5) Project Detail view with compact header, quick links (Docs, Drive, Deadline), and collapsible details section 6) Bottom navigation in project detail with Pages, Tasks, Add, Info, Brand tabs 7) Top tab bar with icons for Pages, Tasks, Requirements, Branding 8) Mobile page cards with phase progress visualization (Wireframe, UI, Content, Dev) 9) Tasks tab with stats cards (Total, Pending, In Progress, Done) and filter pills 10) Create Project modal with 4-step wizard (Type/Platform, Requirements, Branding, Details) - all steps mobile-friendly and scrollable 11) Add Page and Add Task modals mobile-friendly. Note: Bottom nav Info/Brand buttons blocked by Emergent badge in preview env but work via top tab bar.
